Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper shows by far the strongest rise in your cost breakdown; it sounds like recovering that pressure is your main concern. We want a fair, cost-supported adjustment that sustains our long-standing relationship. How can we balance price and payment timing to make the overall agreement work for both sides?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We acknowledge your volume confirmation of 6,110 units, but your requested 90-day payment term incurs substantial financing costs. Our current offer is a price of €374.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. By reverting to our standard 30-day payment terms, we are able to offer a revised price of €369.95 per unit. This alternative is a price of €369.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at our standard terms. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your willingness to reduce the price for earlier payment suggests financing costs are a concrete concern, rather than simply a preference for standard terms. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and are sharing our demand forecast as evidence of the business outlook behind our commitment. How can that stronger demand outlook help us agree a sustainable price for our long-term partnership?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified your updated demand forecast and acknowledge the positive volume outlook, which allows us to adjust our calculation. However, your proposed price remains unfeasible, especially when burdened with the financing costs of a 90-day payment term. 

Our offer stands at a price of €372.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. By returning to our standard terms, we can offer a revised price of €368.74 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your lower price for faster payment makes the financing burden explicit—it sounds like the cost of waiting for payment is a key constraint. We want a sustainable agreement that recognises that burden and supports our long-standing partnership. What room do you see for a measured price adjustment that makes the agreement workable for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.21 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We acknowledge your revised offer, but it remains insufficient to cover the financing costs associated with a 90-day payment term. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In response to your movement, we can offer a measured adjustment to a price of €371.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You tie the remaining price gap directly to financing while making a measured concession—it sounds like covering the cost of carrying payment is the key concern. We value our long-standing partnership and want an agreement that balances payment flexibility with sustainable pricing. What reciprocal movement would allow us to close on that basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 367.11 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate your continued commitment to our partnership.

The financing costs associated with a 90-day payment term remain a significant constraint on our pricing. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In response to your movement, we can offer a further adjustment to a price of €371.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
